policy: The Watcher is an independently versioned desktop companion, not a Next.js route. No numeric score without independently authenticated exact-source, installed-client and multi-platform evidence. The uniform 100-point Index rubric applies; desktop-specific gates are mandatory.

gates.requirement: Exact Watcher Git source, tagged release, published binary SHA-256, downloaded artifact and installed application version independently reconciled; no stale or untracked code.
Live, final, historical and retry uploads preserve immutable bytes, hashes, provenance and server acknowledgments; no silently lost or duplicated final games.
Real Windows/macOS/Linux idle, monitoring, replay upload and streaming cohorts measured against the last qualified release; detect and explain regressions.
Missing/renamed folders, offline mode, midgame restart, failed disk writes and parser backpressure recover without undue upload restrictions or false result authority.
Replay transfer wins over video chunks without interrupting gameplay, leaking capture sources or manufacturing viewer or result evidence.
Paired identity, secrets, telemetry privacy, code-signing and capture consent verified; no wallet custody, betting, signer or settlement authority in Watcher.
Installed Windows, unsigned Mac and Linux update handoffs verified against real binaries, consent, active-play deferral, recovery and rollback.
Electron dependency graph, permissions, reachable code, obsolete paths and source-to-artifact package contents audited without risk-increasing rewrites.
Frozen 1.6.4/1.6.5 replay fixtures, physical-client soak, crashes, EN/FR, both presentations and cross-platform canaries pass before 1.6.6 promotion.
